title: Storm Queen on Phantom Steed
description: A blue-skinned goddess with flowing blue hair and a golden crown rides a spectral black horse through a massive swirling vortex of clouds and lightning. Below, a stormy sea churns with several wooden sailing ships battling the turbulent waves under a dark, lightning-filled sky.
prompt: A majestic blue-skinned goddess with long flowing blue hair, wearing a golden crown and ornate golden armor, rides a glowing spectral black horse through a massive swirling blue vortex of clouds and lightning. She holds a glowing blue orb staff in one hand while commanding the storm with the other. Below her, a turbulent stormy sea with large wooden sailing ships being tossed by massive waves under a dark cloudy sky filled with lightning strikes.
